candidate_a.topology: GitHub Pages frontend (https://algoryxz.github.io/O-Travelz/) + hosted FastAPI backend + Aiven PostgreSQL
pros: GitHub Pages is already configured, live, HTTPS-enforced, and global CDN cached
Hash routing avoids 404 rewrite pitfalls on static hosting
Free, reliable, reproducible from Git SHA
cons: Requires separate backend hosting (Render or hosted container host)

candidate_b.topology: Render static frontend + Render backend (render.yaml) + Aiven PostgreSQL
pros: Single provider blueprint file exists historically in repo
cons: Render static frontend does not exist (HTTP 404)
Render backend is suspended (>120s timeout) due to deleted otravelz-db dependency
Requires manual Render dashboard credentials to resume

candidate_c.topology: Vercel frontend + Render backend + Aiven PostgreSQL
pros: Vercel configuration stub exists in frontend/vercel.json
cons: Requires new cloud provider account linking
Violates rule against adding speculative cloud providers

findings.decision: Use .github/workflows/deploy-pages.yml with VITE_API_URL to deploy current V4 build to gh-pages.
Remove deleted Render PostgreSQL database block and decouple DATABASE_URL from fromDatabase binding.
Expose machine-readable git_sha, alembic_version, status, and database health on /health and minimal build info on /.
Expose window.__OTRAVELZ_BUILD__ with git_sha and build timestamp without cluttering UI.
Retain existing Hash-based routing (window.location.hash) which requires zero server rewrite configuration on GitHub Pages.
If Render service requires human dashboard login to resume, provide exact step-by-step instructions without stalling repository-side recovery.
otravelz.in is non-blocking; document exact operator DNS records.
Database is healthy and migrated at 0020_transit_ride_observations. Zero migration needed.
Reject adding AWS/Fly.io/Vercel/Netlify; Candidate A topology satisfies all requirements with existing assets.
